signal: PrimePay completed its merger with CoAdvantage in June 2025, expanding from standalone payroll to fully outsourced HR, and added an Executive Chairman in Oct 2025

email.body1:
Carol, saw PrimePay completed the CoAdvantage merger, expanding the lineup from standalone payroll to fully outsourced HR.

A bigger product set means more addressable accounts than a regional team can realistically work, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PrimePay off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Carol, quick follow-up for PrimePay.

Post-merger, cross-sell expectations on your area usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your area needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Carol, last bit of proof for PrimePay.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire reps fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peers selling into the same buyers. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Carol, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling area pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating two go-to-market motions after a merger is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to PrimePay either way.
